document.title: Infrastructure Health Report — 2026-03-19
document.content:
# Infrastructure Health Report — March 19, 2026

## Summary
Overall system is operational, but there are specific service failures in PM2 and Docker that require attention. System resources (Disk, RAM, GPU) are within healthy limits.

## Service Status

### PM2 Processes
- **Online:** agent-log, client-ops-api, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, iam-website, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, paperclip, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website.
- **STOPPED:** `whisper` (id 25). This service has 518 restart cycles, suggesting a crash loop or configuration issue.

### Docker Containers
- **Healthy:** postgres:16-alpine (client-ops), scribe-service, nextjs-server, neo4j-server, lidaros-backend, kali-osint, inventree stack, langfuse stack, omiximo-bridge, evolution-api, ollama, n8n.
- **UNHEALTHY:** 
  - `lidaros-frontend-1` (lidaros-frontend)
  - `omiximo-email-automation` (docker-email-automation)

### OpenClaw Gateway
- **Status:** Running (pid 198071)
- **Note:** Multiple gateway-related services detected (clawdbot-*). Doctor warnings regarding groupPolicy allowlists on Telegram/WhatsApp channels.

## System Resources
- **Disk Space:** `/dev/sda1` is at 69% usage (205G available). Healthy.
- **Memory:** 11.5GB used out of 27.5GB. ~16GB available. Healthy.
- **GPU (RTX 4090):** 
  - Temp: 42°C
  - Usage: 22W / 450W
  - Memory: 20.5GB / 24.5GB (VLLM::EngineCore active)
  - Status: Healthy.

## Alerts Sent
- High severity alert issued for `whisper` (stopped) and unhealthy Docker containers (`lidaros-frontend`, `omiximo-email-automation`).
